question: Would a file-only flush or sleep after rename suffice, and what repair/recovery evidence is required?

criteria.instruction: Neither suffices under P17. Write/check full temporary sibling, confirm file flush, rename, confirm parent-directory flush before durable success. Preserve intent ID/prior-new generations and stages; reconcile interrupted intents against the selected generation without creating unrelated duplicate replacements. Inject failures after each stage, retain history and verify honest status/intact recovery.
Ground the sequence in P17, p26 inspection and pending review. Sleep is not a modeled barrier.
Do not claim rollout, delete previous history, certify hardware or treat a partial sequence as durable success.
